product_offering.core_offering: Decagon provides an enterprise AI concierge platform that automates customer support across voice, chat, and email channels through autonomous AI agents. Agents are configured using Agent Operating Procedures (AOPs) — a natural-language framework for defining business workflows — and are deployed with forward-deployed Agent Product Managers who embed with customers to build, optimize, and scale the agents.
product_offering.differentiator: Agent Operating Procedures (AOPs) enabling natural language workflow definition; Self-improving agents with Duet Autopilot that compound performance gains; Over 80% of model traffic running on internally-built proprietary models; Sub-one-second voice latency; Omnichannel (voice, chat, email) with cross-channel memory; Full decision-making transparency and auditability with Trace View and Watchtower; Enterprise-grade governance with human-in-the-loop approvals; Integration with existing CCaaS infrastructure (Five9) and marketplace distribution (Google Cloud)
product_offering.functional_benefit: 60-90%+ ticket deflection rates; 95% cost reduction in support conversations; 24/7 AI concierge availability across all channels; Self-improving agents that compound performance without release cycles; Full transparency into AI decision-making; Enterprise governance with operational sovereignty for CX teams; Automated testing and validation of agent updates; Real-time quality assurance across all conversations
product_offering.problem_solved: High customer support costs; Rising support volume without proportional headcount increase; Lack of visibility into customer interactions; Slow iteration and improvement cycles for AI agents; Complex compliance requirements in regulated industries; Poor deflection rates with legacy chatbots; Rigid IVR systems that frustrate customers; Limited multilingual capabilities
quantifiable_outcome: 80%+ average deflection rates exceeding industry benchmarks
70% resolution rates across chat and voice
85% deflection rate within one month of deployment
50%+ voice call deflection in regulated industries
6x cost reduction with NVIDIA Blackwell architecture
product_offering.product_overview: Decagon is an AI-powered customer experience platform that provides autonomous AI concierge agents for enterprise customer service operations. The platform operates as a unified system combining chat, voice, and email channels within a single intelligence layer. The core technology is Agent Operating Procedures (AOPs), a natural language framework that enables teams to define and iterate agent behavior without code. The product portfolio includes the main AI agent platform with Voice, Chat, and Email channels; Duet (AI partner for agent building with Duet Autopilot for self-improvement); optimization tools including Watchtower (always-on QA), Agent Workbench (debugging assistant), Insights & Reporting, Experiments, Testing & QA, and Suggestions; plus an Integrations module for connecting to enterprise systems. The platform is designed for enterprises across retail, travel, financial services, health & wellness, technology, media, and telecommunications industries.

icp.buyer_persona: Chief Customer Officer, VP of Customer Experience, Head of Contact Center Operations, VP of Digital
icp.description: Large consumer-facing enterprises in retail, e-commerce, and travel/hospitality that handle high-volume customer interactions including order tracking, returns, account management, and travel booking. These customers need 24/7 omnichannel support, multilingual capabilities, and resilience during peak periods (e.g., Rituals handled 9,000 daily cases during holiday season). Decision dynamics involve proof-of-value pilots with live A/B testing against competitor platforms, with average reported deflection rates of 60–90%+ and quantifiable revenue impacts from AI-handled conversations (e.g., $1M revenue from fully AI-handled conversations at Hunter Douglas).
evidence_proof_points: Hunter Douglas: $1M revenue from fully AI-handled conversations, 85% higher AOV among AI-interacting customers
Rituals: 9,000 daily cases handled with zero backlog during peak holiday season
Faire: automated repetitive inquiries and streamlined returns
pain_points: High support volume and rising customer expectations
Cost-intensive human agents for routine inquiries
Lack of visibility into customer interactions
Peak season backlog and scaling challenges

Duet Autopilot launch (June 2026) with self-improving agent loop and DuetBench evaluation framework introduces an autonomous operations layer, expanding the platform surface from agent deployment to autonomous agent lifecycle management.

ElevenLabs voice model partnership (December 2025) and re-architecture onto NVIDIA Blackwell stack signal expansion into a deeper voice AI stack and infrastructure partnership that supports outcome-based / per-resolution pricing models.

Inclusion in the inaugural a16z FDE Fellowship cohort (June 2026) and continued build-out of Decagon Labs and Agent PM function point to expanded hiring for forward-deployed engineering and applied AI research talent.

Google Cloud Marketplace listing, Five9 CX Marketplace accreditation, and OpenAI Frontier design partner status open three distinct third-party distribution channels for enterprise procurement motions.
